SELECT TO_CHAR(SEQ_RENT_CTRT.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO RENT_CTRT ( RENT_CTRT_NO, RENT_LSTG_NO, CTRT_ID, MVIN_YN, MVIN_DT, MVOUT_DT, MVOUT_CMPL_DT, REG_DT, MDF_DT, CTRT_STTS_CD, CTRT_AMT, MID_PAY_AMT, BAL_AMT, DPST_AMT, MTHLY_RENT_AMT, USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{rentCtrtNo}, #{rentLstgNo}, #{ctrtId}, #{mvinYn},
TO_DATE(#{mvinDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL ,
TO_DATE(#{mvoutDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL ,
TO_DATE(#{mvoutCmplDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ctrtSttsCd}, #{ctrtAmt}, #{midPayAmt}, #{balAmt}, #{dpstAmt}, #{mthlyRentAmt}, #{userNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RENT_CTRT rc JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO JOIN RENT_LISTING rl ON rl.RENT_LSTG_NO = rc.RENT_LSTG_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_no, apt_cmplex_no FROM ( SELECT rr.USER_NO, rr.APT_CMPLEX_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rr.USER_NO ORDER BY rr.RCPT_DT DESC) AS rn FROM RESIDENT_RQST rr ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rr1 ON rr1.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = rr1.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE 1=1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rc.REG_DT DESC) AS rn, rc.RENT_CTRT_NO AS rentCtrtNo, rl.RENT_TYPE_CD AS rentTypeCd, m.USER_ID AS userId, ac.APT_CMPLEX_NM AS aptCmplexNm, to_char(rc.MVIN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mvinDt, to_char(rc.MVOUT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mvoutDt, rc.REG_DT AS regDt, rc.CTRT_STTS_CD AS ctrtSttsCd FROM RENT_CTRT rc JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO JOIN RENT_LISTING rl ON rl.RENT_LSTG_NO = rc.RENT_LSTG_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_no, apt_cmplex_no FROM ( SELECT rr.USER_NO, rr.APT_CMPLEX_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rr.USER_NO ORDER BY rr.RCPT_DT DESC) AS rn FROM RESIDENT_RQST rr ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rr1 ON rr1.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = rr1.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE 1=1
) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

select rc.RENT_CTRT_NO as rentCtrtNo, rc.RENT_LSTG_NO as rentLstgNo, m.USER_ID as userId, m.USER_NO as userNo, rc.CTRT_ID as ctrtId, rc.CTRT_STTS_CD as ctrtSttsCd, rl.RENT_TYPE_CD as rentTypeCd, ac.apt_cmplex_nm as aptCmplexNm, rc.ctrt_amt as ctrtAmt, rc.DPST_AMT as dpstAmt, to_char(rc.MVIN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mvinDt, to_char(rc.MVOUT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as mvoutDt, to_char(rc.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regDt from RENT_CTRT rc inner join member m on rc.USER_NO = m.user_no inner join RENT_LISTING rl on rc.rent_lstg_no = rl.RENT_LSTG_NO left join ( select user_no, APT_CMPLEX_NO from ( select user_no, apt_cmplex_no, row_number() over (partition by USER_NO order by RCPT_DT desc) rn from RESIDENT_RQST )
where rn = 1 ) rr1 on rr1.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO left join apt_complex ac on ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = rr1.APT_CMPLEX_NO where rc.RENT_CTRT_NO = #{rentCtrtNo}
select APT_CMPLEX_NO, APT_CMPLEX_NM from APT_COMPLEX order by APT_CMPLEX_NO asc
select count(*) from CNTRCT_FRM cf join APT_COMPLEX ac on ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = cf.APT_CMPLEX_NO where 1=1

select * from( select row_number() over (order by cf.REG_DT desc ) as rn, cf.frm_no as frmNo, cf.frm_nm as frmNm, cf.apt_cmplex_no as aptCmplexNo, ac.apt_cmplex_nm as aptCmplexNm, cf.rent_type_cd as rentTypeCd, to_char(cf.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regDt from CNTRCT_FRM CF inner join apt_complex ac on ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = cf.APT_CMPLEX_NO where 1=1
) where rn between #{startRow} and #{endRow}

SELECT cf.FRM_NO AS frmNo, cf.FRM_NM AS frmNm, cf.APT_CMPLEX_NO AS aptCmplexNo, ac.APT_CMPLEX_NM AS aptCmplexNm, cf.RENT_TYPE_CD AS rentTypeCd, TO_CHAR(cf.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDt, cf.FILE_NO AS fileNo FROM CNTRCT_FRM cf inner join APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = cf.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE cf.FRM_NO = #{frmNo}
